Hi zp[@zpuser#898913996#Garry Caber]zp,

Please see feedback from the client below:
  1. General remarks
    • Change verbiage, do not mention Shanna's name. Use "we" or "our team" - apply in app and emails
  2. How would you like to get started?
    • Both Free Consultation Call and Request a proposal are for new clients
    • Change "I received a proposal" to "Ask for a proposal"
    • Ask for a proposal should lead to a page with a short form (Name, Address, Email, Contact number, Primary concern) - purely for inquiry
  3. Free Consultation Call
    • Primary concern - change to a text box, not a dropdown
    • Remove bottom text field
    • Shanna would like this to be a video call. As much as possible, therapists should not contact the client outside of the app
  4. Send proposal
    1. For the services, make it a checkbox for each service - admin can select multiple services for the client
    2. In the PDF, please fix the overlapping content bugs
    3. For the Send Custom Email, can we set it to choose Zoho Mail as default?
  5. Intake Form
    • Please follow the fields from their provided file.
    • When adding a profile photo, there is an error in submitting.
  6. Client Pool
    • In this client pool, therapists can choose which ones to take.
    • Let's create a prompt for clients that are not taken within 2 days. This should notify the admin so she can coordinate with the therapists.
  7. Payment Confirmed Email
    1. Currently, this gets sent when there is already a therapist assigned. Can we do this even before then?
    2. This doesn't include the invoice attached as well. Please recheck.
  8. Packaged sessions
    1. Client and therapist should set these schedules ahead
  9. Session reminders
    1. Is this in place already?
  10. Business Details
    1. Change to "Elodi Online Therapy and Learning Center" everywhere
    2. Can we create a logo for this based on the brand colors and business scope?
  11. Session Room
    1. I encountered a bug when I joined the room and agreed to the recording, it logged me out. Might be a one-time thing but best to check as well.
    2. Therapist should also have an option to pause the recording
    3. Add in the 5-minutes notice when the session is about to end
    4. The session should be ended manually by the therapist. This will allow them an allowance for extension.
    5. Can we add another column for notes aside from the chat box?
  12. Release Report
    1. This is for the Evaluation Report. Make sure these are just text boxes that therapists will have to input their findings. Please refer to the file attached.
  13. Existing clients
    1. Shanna has existing clients that she would like to bring to the app for additional testing. How do we bypass the steps? Can we just add their emails directly?
  14. Payment
    1. Right now, the "pay first before session" rule is not a priority. She can do manual for now in the testing phase. Clients can pay after the session or within the week.

Please let me know if you have any questions. Thank you!
